reviewer: History section agent; AI editorial cross-review, not external scientific peer review
coverage: All 33 Science lessons and all 33 evidence notes read. Access records considered. Focus: unsupported precision, historical/evolutionary inference, laboratory-versus-universal claims, clarity, distinctiveness and reader rhythm. Three underlying public primary/institutional sources independently reopened for spot checks; not all sources rechecked.
result: No high- or medium-severity factual issue identified. Two minor precision/clarity edits and one optional acronym clarification recommended. None requires a chapter rewrite.

findings.current_text: The result describes the sample's acid-neutralizing demand under those conditions.
findings.issue: Acid-neutralizing demand can be momentarily read as capacity to neutralize added acid, the alkalinity concept later explained in lesson 56. The preceding sentence is correct; explicit wording would keep the distinction effortless. This is a wording clarification, not a claim that the passage uses the wrong test.
findings.suggested_edit: The result expresses how much base the sample requires to reach that endpoint.
findings.evidence: Official ASBC public explanatory page reopened during review: Beer 8 adds a measured amount of sodium hydroxide to the test sample to an endpoint. Do not add operational quantities or procedural instructions to the book.

findings.current_text: A 2026 investigation by Seyedomid Ahmadinejad and colleagues followed a reactor using real brewery wastewater for 365 days.
findings.issue: The current text correctly limits universality but does not identify the physical scale. The opened primary protocol describes a laboratory apparatus with 0.65 L effective working volume, not a year-long whole-brewery installation. One added word prevents a large mental-picture difference.
findings.suggested_edit: A 2026 investigation by Seyedomid Ahmadinejad and colleagues followed a laboratory reactor using real brewery wastewater for 365 days.
findings.evidence: Primary JoVE abstract, feed/inoculum, reactor configuration and experimental-design sections independently inspected during cross-review. They confirm duration, use of real wastewater and a laboratory-scale system. Exact operating values need not enter the narrative.

findings.current_text: The WSET's malt education uses this progression to explain why gentle kilning and more intense roasting produce different sensory and functional outcomes.
findings.issue: WSET appears without expansion in a book assuming no prior brewing knowledge. Naming the educational organization makes the attribution useful to a general reader.
findings.suggested_edit: Malt education from the Wine & Spirit Education Trust uses this progression to explain why gentle kilning and more intense roasting produce different sensory and functional outcomes.
findings.evidence: Organization expanded for readability; underlying educational source already recorded by the Science author. This review did not reopen that page.

strengths_checked: Yeast evolution and domestication distinguish sampled industrial populations, reconstructed ancestry and historical transport routes.
Lager hybrid ancestry is not made into proof of a transatlantic itinerary or first brewery.
Sake and tapé are connected by a biochemical problem without collapsing cultural identities or asserting common descent.
Sesotho batch-replication limits and umqombothi function-prediction limits are explicit and understandable.
Equal bitterness, titratable acidity, triangle tests, color and label expectations each pose a substantively distinct measurement question.
Light chemistry, aldehyde availability, haze, bubbles and foam remain distinct mechanisms rather than repeated flavor summaries.
The LTP1 source spot check supports the bounded heating/structure/foam explanation without a finished-beer guarantee.
Agricultural projections remain assumptions-dependent, and alpha acids are not confused with all hop aroma.
Carbon/water accounting, packaging logistics, thermal integration and digestion address different systems questions.
The manuscript contains no numerical environmental rankings presented without their model boundaries and no unsupported health or food-safety assurance.

spot_checked_sources.access: Official public explanatory page and indexed freely available method excerpt inspected. No full paid standards access claimed.
Complete original research abstract inspected; heat-induced LTP1 changes and foam scope confirmed.
Primary abstract and relevant protocol/design sections inspected; laboratory scale and 365-day period confirmed.

unresolved_review_limits: The Science author’s inherited-only-source and abstract-only access limitations remain; a second AI reading is not independent expert validation.
No data reanalysis, laboratory replication or exhaustive verification of all cited full texts was performed.
The above small edits can be applied during master assembly without changing evidence strength or selection.
